p5.description: P5, the other disciplines, the outer stores and the joins (decision 48 and the P5 design v3). W0 adds the queue parity golden, which pins the queue at the commit of decision 45. S1 adds the engine spine: the family agent, Discipline v2 with the head driver, the Cx primitives, the outer-store hooks, the DR-75 order of the substrate, and the shared harness of the P5 suites. The batches add their sources, entry points, tests and property files. Wave W2 adds the bag, cell and stack disciplines with the scan driver and the settle loop, the Array and Vector stores with the allocator, the pure PathMap layer, the P5 factory rows, the hooks of receive queries and allocation jobs, the engine properties, and one fire count for each transaction (I-21). Its property tests use the shared runner of rholang/tests/support/props.rs. Wave W3 adds the join engine and the PathMap engine of Phase 1 with their entry points. The compiler keeps the retired OrderedJoinUnsupported out of the code, because its variant is commented out.

p6.description: Phase P6, the VectorDB family and its ChromaDB search backend (design v3). Step 1 adds the generic prerequisites: the config of a plan, the waiter policy of version 1 and of a join slot (Nil, a priority-queue level, a VectorDB query), the record codecs of a VectorDB space, and the bound of a side with CapacityExceeded. Step 2 adds the exact numeric core: the ingress of every number kind, the exact kernels, the squared-form decisions, the score orders, the selection order and the correctly rounded delivered values. Step 3 (design steps 3 and 4) adds the VectorDB driver and its paths in the join engine: the config, the query checks, the records, the selection, single mode, list mode, OFFER-VDB, LIST-CASCADE, Rule E with the carry at the round cap, the family and the factory rows, and ListModeInJoin. Step 6 adds rho:lang:vector: add, scale, dot, norm and distance, exact in the widest kind of the inputs, the replies [true, value] and [false, code, detail], the packing of a call into [ret, [op, x…]] and the metering of the process. Step 7a adds the recorded processes rho:vectordb:embed and rho:vectordb:ann with their replies [true, ...] and [false, code, detail], the node-local services with the unavailable defaults and the feature-gated SBERT and ChromaDB backends, the checks of an ann call in play and in replay, and the mirror entry of the config reply. Step 7b adds the mirror journal: the capture of the net writes of a transaction of a mirrored space, the journal of an evaluation, the publication of the journal with a final result without errors (M1), and the mirror writer with its bounded queue, its bounded retry and its dirty collections. Step 7c adds the mirror reconciler: the channel registry in the collection metadata, the repair of every registered channel to the finalized state (orphans deleted, missing records added, the watermark set, dirty collections repaired), the coalescing loop over the BlockFinalised events, and the node state of two read-only closures.
